newsitem.title: CHINA: China Shengli oilfield finds reserves, output down.
newsitem.headline: China Shengli oilfield finds reserves, output down.

text.p: China's Shengli oilfield, the nation's second largest, has verified another 45.5 million tonnes of oil reserves but production this year is still likely to be below the 1996 level, an oil official said on Wednesday.
He did not give a figure for total reserves but said the latest estimate of additional proven reserves was made as of the end of April.
"This will not increase production too much," the official told Reuters by telephone.

He added that the oilfield in the eastern province of Shandong was trying to maintain production at its target level of 28 million tonnes this year, down from actual production of 29 million tonnes in 1996.
Shengli, one of China's older oilfields, expected to invest 1.67 billion yuan ($201 million) in exploration this year, the official said.
